NOTE
**Still not ready**

The author started a discussion thread on chat.zulip.org, and the link is already in the PR description. There was no new push.

|     |         |
| --- | ------- |
| ✅  | The discussion link is now in the PR description, which was the ask. |
| ⚠️  | The thread has only the author's own post. No maintainer has said this change is wanted. |
| ❌  | PR #40042 by the same author makes the same kind of change ("more bare .save() calls"). The two should probably be combined or one closed. |
| ❌  | "Fixes:" is empty, and "How changes were tested" only says "Verified no test failures". |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" until a maintainer replies in the discussion thread, and ask the author to sort out the overlap with #40042.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for starting the discussion! Please wait for a maintainer to weigh in there before we review this. In the meantime, #40042 looks like the same kind of change, so please combine the two or close one, and fill in the "Fixes:" line and a more specific testing description.
```
